propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross core as opaque payloads via port calls at emission and ingestion boundaries.
All package-root reconciler modules must have zero imports of adapters.jira or lazy-key literals, with sole exemption for inbound_fields.py pending relocation.
Remaining children must implement canonical field diff, canonical link diff, vendor absence probe, and rich-text/comment-limit routing through the port to achieve core neutrality.
Backend is selected via config.reconciler.backend through a registry with default 'jira' preserving prior behavior.
Eight vendor modules are physically relocated under adapters/jira/ with loaders repointed and no re-export shims.
All src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*.py modules must respect the 800-LOC module-size gate and remain behavior-preserving.
